newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end 3-day rise, fall on profit-take.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end 3-day rise, fall on profit-take.

text.p: Caracas stocks failed to break key resistance and closed off in heavy trade as investors took profits after a straight three-day rise that had sent the bolsa soaring, traders said.
"Today's fall was logical after such significant rises ... investors were just taking profits," said Vencred broker Ernesto Castillo.
The bolsa's 19-share index closed down 0.53 percent at 6,496.97 as 47 million shares traded worth six billion bolivars ($12.5 million). Among traded issues, 16 fell, 12 rose and nine closed flat.
Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, meanwhile closed down 0.64 percent at 191.98 points.
"Today's fall was a technical adjustment," said Financorp broker Gustavo Hernandez.
The bourse had risen some three percent on strong foreign bids in recent days on a slew of favourable comments by the IMF on Venezuela's economic adjustment program.
